summary: Added 'number' to genericIDFieldFallbacks so OData Number-keyed entities (DidNumber, etc.) cache instead of dropping silently.
reason: OData/Microsoft.OpenApi.OData specs key some entities on PascalCase Number with no id; the default fallback list lacked 'number', so sync stored 0 rows with no error.
validated_outcome: did-numbers synced 35 rows after the fix (0 before).
